references.title: Designing Instructional Text in a Conversational Style: A Meta-Analysis
references.note: Abstract reports retention and transfer benefits, with a duration boundary. Does not validate universal friendliness or every textbook chapter.

references.authors: Lupo, Tortorelli, Invernizzi, Ryoo and Strong
references.title: An Exploration of Text Difficulty and Knowledge Support on Adolescents' Comprehension
references.note: Publisher abstract: 293 ninth graders, 24 texts over 12 weeks with instructional supports. Most showed similar comprehension; a small substantially below-average subgroup benefited from easier versions. Not equivalence or independent-reading validation.
